threshold.explicitlyOutside: analyze RSS and doctor-with-consented-probes RSS remain outside D-006

harness.matrix: same D-102 fleet class; --help/--version cold/warm RSS plus one doctor read-only launch per sample
harness.protocol: D-102 G04 series: 21 samples; every accepted sample must be ≤ the D-006 bound (not only the percentile). doctor read-only is one launch per sample, no warm pair. Path/digest identity and preflight are the D-102 contract.
harness.exactByteIntent: Per platform: 21 RSS traces for --help, --version, and doctor read-only, each with the rssProtocol retained raw samples and derived steady/peak. The fixture pins those traces.
harness.passProperty: Sampling follows rssProtocol. --help/--version use the same cold/warm pairing as G03. doctor read-only is one launch. analyze and consented-probe RSS are not scored. Bound comparison waits on the D-006 unit successor.
failsIf: analyze or consented-probe RSS is scored as this gate
doctor read-only is given a warm pair as if it were help/version
Rosetta or a non-D-102 class is used
samples are taken of the job VM rather than T
this specification is read as authorizing a binary-MB byte constant
harness.doesNotClaim: QUALIFIED. Does not execute. Does not invent analyze RSS bounds.

rssProtocol.scope: The spawned measurement process T only. Not the job VM. Not sibling processes.
rssProtocol.linuxPrimitive: /proc/T/status VmRSS (kB) * 1024 = bytes per sample. Sample every 10 ms from the D-102 exec handshake to T exit. peak = max sample. steady = median of samples at or after 20 ms; if the process exits sooner, median of all samples.
rssProtocol.macosPrimitive: task_info(T, TASK_VM_INFO) resident_size bytes per sample. Same 10 ms window, peak, and steady derivation. APIs are those on MacOSX15.4.sdk. PROC_PIDARCHINFO is not used.
rssProtocol.unit: Raw bytes are retained. Comparison to D-006 40/50/60/100 MB is scored only after the same D-006 unit successor named at d006UnitStanding. Until then every sample is recorded and no invented byte constant is used as a pass/fail bound.
rssProtocol.retained: Every raw sample timestamp and value, plus the derived steady and peak, per accepted job.
